verdict.rationale: The CRA offers digital services such as online business registration, e-services portals and EFILE transmission, so an official CLI is a fair question. The evidence shows no first-party command-line tool. EFILE runs through third-party certified tax software, which is adjacent and earns no credit, and the llms.txt probe found no agent-oriented resources.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
